Question 4
?

If f(x,y)=arctan⁡xy and r(t)=eti+sin⁡tj, compute ddt[f(r(t))].

a
 et(sin⁡t+1)1+e2tsin2⁡t
b
et(sin⁡t+cos⁡t)1+e2tsin2⁡t
c
 et(cos⁡t+1)1+e2tsin2⁡t
d
 sin⁡t+et1+e2tsin2⁡t
e
 et−cos⁡t1+e2tsin2⁡t
